moves.label: Gum-Gum Pistol
moves.description: Fast high stretchy jab with a tiny active window for close checks.
moves.reason: Classic stretched fist poke at upper-body height.

moves.label: Gum-Gum Gatling
moves.description: Slow mid twin assault with a long active rush of stretched punches.
moves.reason: Repeated forward fists read as a Gatling-style barrage.

moves.label: Gum-Gum Upper Launcher
moves.description: Fast mid launcher with a moderate active uppercut and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Upward rubber strike is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Gum-Gum Balloon Tornado
moves.description: Quick mid tornado spin with a moderate active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Inflated spinning body is authored as a tornado.

moves.label: Low Gum-Gum Feint
moves.description: Slow low feint with a short active burst and very quick recovery.
moves.reason: Low crouched setup drops into a ground-level rubber burst.

moves.label: Gum-Gum Red Drive
moves.description: Slow low knockdown drive with extended active red-streak pressure.
moves.reason: Red low driving sequence is authored as a knockdown.

moves.label: Gum-Gum Giant Rifle
moves.description: Fast mid knockdown punch with very long active rubber-arm reach.
moves.reason: Huge extended fist barrage is authored as a knockdown.

moves.label: Gum-Gum Stamp Barrage
moves.description: Fast mid crouching barrage with long active giant-fist pressure.
moves.reason: Crouch sequence summons repeated vertical rubber fists.

moves.label: Crouch Gum-Gum Launcher
moves.description: Fast mid launcher with very long active lift and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Crouch strike is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Overdrive Pistol
moves.description: Fast high overdrive Pistol with a brief active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive command reuses the stretched high jab.

moves.label: Gum-Gum Aura Drive
moves.description: Fast special knockdown dash with very long active rubber-body pressure.
moves.reason: Fast aura drive is authored as a special knockdown.

moves.label: Gum-Gum Rising Stamp
moves.description: Fast mid rising strike with very long active pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: While-rising rubber-limb strike covers mid space.

moves.label: Ducking Gum-Gum Pistol
moves.description: Fast high ducking Pistol with a brief active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Down jab reuses the stretched high Pistol.

moves.label: Gum-Gum Spear Rush
moves.description: Fast mid advancing stretch rush with very long active reach.
moves.reason: Forward command stretches Luffy across the screen into a rush.

moves.label: Gum-Gum Rush Pistol
moves.description: Fast high rush Pistol with a brief active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle jab uses the stretched high punch.
